objectives: Solve the Topic 6: Advanced OOPs Concepts - Exercises exercises without looking at the lesson
Test edge cases and explain your approach

sections.title: Exercise 1: Advanced Date/Time Class with Class Methods
sections.body:
Create a `DateTime` class with:
- Class methods for creating instances from different formats (string, timestamp, ISO format)
- Static methods for date validation and utility functions
- Magic methods for date arithmetic and comparison
- Properties for computed values (day of week, quarter, etc.)
- Factory methods for common date patterns (start of month, end of year)

sections.title: Exercise 2: Matrix Class with Magic Methods
sections.body:
Create a `Matrix` class with:
- Magic methods for arithmetic operations (`+`, `-`, `*`, `/`)
- Comparison magic methods (`==`, `!=`, `<`, `>`)
- Indexing magic methods (`__getitem__`, `__setitem__`)
- String representation magic methods (`__str__`, `__repr__`)
- Class methods for creating special matrices (identity, zero, random)
- Static methods for matrix operations (determinant, transpose)

sections.title: Exercise 3: Database Connection Pool with Metaclass
sections.body:
Create a database connection pool system with:
- Metaclass for singleton pattern implementation
- Class methods for pool management (get_connection, release_connection)
- Static methods for connection validation and health checks
- Properties for pool statistics (active_connections, available_connections)
- Context manager support for automatic connection management

sections.title: Exercise 4: Validated Configuration Class with Descriptors
sections.body:
Create a `Configuration` class with:
- Descriptors for different data types (StringConfig, IntConfig, BoolConfig)
- Validation rules (min/max values, allowed values, format validation)
- Class methods for loading from different sources (file, environment, API)
- Static methods for configuration validation and schema checking
- Properties for computed configuration values

sections.title: Exercise 5: Advanced Collection with Magic Methods
sections.body:
Create a `SmartList` class that extends list functionality with:
- Magic methods for arithmetic operations with other lists
- Custom iteration and slicing behavior
- Context manager support for batch operations
- Class methods for creating from different data sources
- Static methods for list analysis and statistics
- Properties for computed values (sum, average, unique items)

sections.title: Exercise 6: Event System with Metaclasses and Descriptors
sections.body:
Create an event system with:
- Metaclass for automatic event registration
- Descriptors for event properties with validation
- Class methods for event creation and management
- Static methods for event filtering and processing
- Magic methods for event comparison and combination
- Properties for event statistics and metadata

sections.title: Exercise 7: Advanced Calculator with Class Methods and Properties
sections.body:
Create a `Calculator` class with:
- Class methods for different calculation modes (scientific, financial, statistical)
- Static methods for mathematical constants and utility functions
- Properties for calculation history and memory
- Magic methods for calculator operations
- Factory methods for specialized calculators
- Context manager for calculation sessions

sections.title: Exercise 8: File System Manager with Context Managers
sections.body:
Create a `FileSystemManager` class with:
- Context manager support for file operations
- Class methods for file type detection and creation
- Static methods for file validation and utilities
- Magic methods for file comparison and operations
- Properties for file metadata and statistics
- Factory methods for different file types

sections.title: Exercise 9: Advanced Logger with Metaclasses and Descriptors
sections.body:
Create a logging system with:
- Metaclass for automatic logger registration
- Descriptors for log level validation
- Class methods for logger configuration and management
- Static methods for log analysis and filtering
- Magic methods for log comparison and combination
- Properties for log statistics and performance metrics

sections.title: Exercise 10: Plugin System with Advanced OOPs Features
sections.body:
Create a plugin system with:
- Metaclass for plugin registration and lifecycle management
- Descriptors for plugin configuration and validation
- Class methods for plugin discovery and loading
- Static methods for plugin compatibility checking
- Magic methods for plugin comparison and operations
- Properties for plugin metadata and status

sections.title: Optional Challenges
sections.body:
### Challenge 1: Advanced ORM with Metaclasses
Build an ORM system with:
- Metaclass for automatic table creation and mapping
- Descriptors for field validation and type conversion
- Class methods for query building and execution
- Static methods for database utilities and migrations
- Magic methods for model comparison and operations
- Properties for model relationships and computed fields

### Challenge 2: Advanced Caching System
Create a caching system with:
- Metaclass for cache configuration and management
- Descriptors for cache key generation and validation
- Class methods for cache operations and statistics
- Static methods for cache analysis and optimization
- Magic methods for cache comparison and operations
- Properties for cache performance and hit rates

### Challenge 3: Advanced Serialization Framework
Build a serialization framework with:
- Metaclass for automatic serialization registration
- Descriptors for serialization format and validation
- Class methods for serialization and deserialization
- Static methods for format detection and conversion
- Magic methods for object comparison and merging
- Properties for serialization metadata and statistics

### Challenge 4: Advanced Testing Framework
Create a testing framework with:
- Metaclass for automatic test discovery and registration
- Descriptors for test configuration and validation
- Class methods for test execution and reporting
- Static methods for test analysis and filtering
- Magic methods for test comparison and combination
- Properties for test statistics and performance metrics

### Challenge 5: Advanced Configuration Management
Build a configuration management system with:
- Metaclass for configuration schema and validation
- Descriptors for configuration values and constraints
- Class methods for configuration loading and saving
- Static methods for configuration analysis and validation
- Magic methods for configuration comparison and merging
- Properties for configuration metadata and dependencies
